facts.fact: The minister announced on 17 April 2017 the official launch of the education ministry's information system, to run first as an experiment in the third term of 2016-17 before nationwide generalisation in 2017-18.

facts.fact: The ministry's secretary-general said the system will give each pupil a national identity number across the whole schooling, with daily management of absences, SMS to parents on absences and electronic report cards.
facts.system: système d'information du ministère de l'Éducation nationale

facts.fact: The system is the Ministry of National Education's own information system, announced by the minister.
